questions.question: What does God promise to foreigners and eunuchs who keep his covenant in Isaiah 56?
options: A full and complete freedom from all of the laws of the covenant
A name and a place in his house, better than sons and daughters
Very great riches and broad lands among the tribes of Israel
A high and glorious throne from which to rule over the nations
questions.answer: A name and a place in his house, better than sons and daughters

questions.question: What will God's house be called, according to Isaiah 56?
options: A fortress against the surrounding nations
A house of prayer for all peoples
A treasury for the wealth of kings
A court for judging the tribes of Israel
questions.answer: A house of prayer for all peoples

questions.question: Isaiah 56 condemns Israel's blind watchmen as silent dogs who cannot bark and love to sleep.
My house shall be called a house of _____ for all peoples.
Keep justice, and do righteousness, for soon my salvation will come and my righteousness be _____.
